source_text:
9.34
Ει πε γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ· Οὐ ζη τήσει. ̓Αλλὰ κα ν μυριακὶς ἐκεῖνος ταῦτα λογί
σηται, σὺ βλέπεις· τοῦτο γὰρ νοητέον.
pass_a_gloss: He-said for in heart of-him: Not he-will-seek. But even-if ten-thousand-times that-one these should-reason, you see; this for is-to-be-understood.
pass_b_english: “For he said in his heart: He will not seek” (Psalm 9:34).
But even if he should reason these things ten thousand times, you see; for this is to be understood.

choices.why: Addressed to God against the sinner’s inner speech. Not ‘you, the sinner, see’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
